 Follow Jacob Elordi Sets His Heart on Kendall Jenner as His Future Wife — Source
 Aman Sharma Wed, October 28, 2026 at 3:14 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo by Stefanie Keenan/Oscars/Getty Images for Academy Museum Foundation Jacob Elordi reportedly sees a future with Kendall Jenner , with a source claiming the actor sees her as marriage material. The insider suggested the couple's relationship has grown more serious in the past few months.
 Jacob Elordi has 'given every indication' he wants to marry Kendall Jenner, per source
 Jacob Elordi and Kendall Jenner's relationship is a lot more serious than we think. A source told InTouch Weekly that the Euphoria star has his heart on Jenner as his future wife. A source said, "Kendall Jenner has identified boyfriend Jacob Elordi as marriage material. Jacob doesn't really enjoy the single life, and when he falls for somebody, he falls hard. He's also looking down the barrel of turning 30 next year, and he's ready to settle down."
 Elordi and Jenner sparked dating rumors when they were spotted together at Vanity Fair Oscars in 2026. However, they first met in 2022 when Elordi attended Jenner's birthday party.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The source said Jenner "is basically in the same place in her life, which is why marriage has been such a heavy topic of conversation between the two of them." It's been months since they both started dating; sources insisted their relationship got serious fast.
 Previously, it was reported that the Australian star is living with Jenner temporarily while they are searching for a home. The source also suggested Elordi's changing outlook on LA reflects his growing interest in building a relationship with the supermodel.
 A source added, "Jacob used to hate coming to L.A. for work, but she has completely turned him around on the place, and he's actually looking forward to building a future with her there. Of course, part of that process means accommodating the Kardashian family's reality TV empire and the intrusive presence of cameras that goes along with it."
 ​While neither Jenner nor Elordi has publicly confirmed the status of their relationship, reports suggest the relationship might be moving to a more committed future.
